title: The Revolt Against Rehoboam

questions.question: Where did Rehoboam go to be made king?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 10:1 (ESV): "Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king."

questions.question: Who returned from Egypt when he heard the news?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 10:2 (ESV): "And as soon as Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard of it (for he was in Egypt...)"

questions.question: What did the people ask Rehoboam to do?
options: Lighten the hard service and heavy yoke
questions.correctAnswer: Lighten the hard service and heavy yoke
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 10:4 (ESV): "...now lighten the hard service of your father and his heavy yoke..."

questions.question: Whose counsel did Rehoboam reject?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 10:8 (ESV): "But he abandoned the counsel that the old men gave him..."

questions.question: What did the young men advise Rehoboam to say?
options: My little finger is thicker than my father's thighs
questions.correctAnswer: My little finger is thicker than my father's thighs
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 10:10 (ESV): "...Thus shall you speak to them: 'My little finger is thicker than my father's thighs.'"

questions.question: How did Rehoboam answer the people?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 10:13 (ESV): "And the king answered them harshly..."

questions.question: What was the result of the king not listening?
options: It was a turn of affairs brought about by God
questions.correctAnswer: It was a turn of affairs brought about by God
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 10:15 (ESV): "So the king did not listen to the people, for it was a turn of affairs brought about by God..."

questions.question: Which prophecy was being fulfilled?
options: The word the LORD spoke by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam
questions.correctAnswer: The word the LORD spoke by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 10:15 (ESV): "...that the LORD might fulfill his word, which he spoke by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam..."

questions.question: What cry did all Israel raise when the king refused to listen?
options: What portion have we in David? We have no inheritance in the son of Jesse
questions.correctAnswer: What portion have we in David? We have no inheritance in the son of Jesse
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 10:16 (ESV): "...What portion have we in David? We have no inheritance in the son of Jesse..."

questions.question: Over whom did Rehoboam reign?
options: The people of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah
questions.correctAnswer: The people of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 10:17 (ESV): "But Rehoboam reigned over the people of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah."

questions.question: Who did Rehoboam send to the people, and what happened to him?
options: Hadoram, who was taskmaster over the forced labor; he was stoned to death
questions.correctAnswer: Hadoram, who was taskmaster over the forced labor; he was stoned to death
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 10:18 (ESV): "Then King Rehoboam sent Hadoram... and the people of Israel stoned him to death with stones."

questions.question: Where did everyone go after the rebellion?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 10:16 (ESV): "...Each of you to your tents, O Israel!"

questions.question: How did Rehoboam escape?
options: He mounted his chariot hurriedly to flee to Jerusalem
questions.correctAnswer: He mounted his chariot hurriedly to flee to Jerusalem
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 10:18 (ESV): "...King Rehoboam mounted his chariot hurriedly to flee to Jerusalem."

questions.question: How long has Israel been in rebellion against the house of David?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 10:19 (ESV): "So Israel has been in rebellion against the house of David to this day."

questions.question: With what did Rehoboam threaten to discipline the people?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 10:11 (ESV): "...but I will discipline you with scorpions."

key_verse_text: And when all Israel saw that the king did not listen to them, the people answered the king, “What portion have we in David? We have no inheritance in the son of Jesse. Each of you to your tents, O Israel! Look now to your own house, David.”
